name: PT Arkadia Digital Media Tbk
summary: PT Arkadia Digital Media Tbk operates as an independent and integrated digital media company in Indonesia. It operates Suara.com, a news portal; Matamata.com, a celebrity and entertainment portal; Bolatimes.com, a soccer and sports portal; and Hitekno.com, a technology and gadget portal. The company also operates Dewiku.com, a platform for females; Mobimoto.com, an automotive and motorsports portal; Guideku.com, a travelling, and food and beverage portal; and Himedik.com, a health and medical portal. In addition, it offers content for mobile phone subscribers through Arkadia Mobile; produces video content for clients ranging from government institutions to corporations; and provides event management services. The company was formerly known as PT Bukit Irama and changed its name to PT Arkadia Digital Media Tbk in February 2018. PT Arkadia Digital Media Tbk was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Central Jakarta, Indonesia.
